title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
prompt:
Return the `k`-th largest element in `nums` (the k-th in sorted-descending order, not the k-th distinct).

**Example**: `nums = [3,2,1,5,6,4]`, `k = 2` → `5`.

The size-k min-heap pattern: keep only the k largest seen; its minimum is the answer.
hints: Min-heap capped at size k: offer each number, poll when size exceeds k.
The heap ends holding the k largest values; its top (minimum of those) is the k-th largest.
O(n log k). (Quickselect gives O(n) average if you want to go further.)

solution.explanation: Evicting the smallest whenever the heap exceeds k means it always contains exactly the k biggest elements seen so far, so its minimum is the k-th largest overall. O(n log k) time, O(k) space.
